description: A comforting Kenyan stew of black-eyed peas simmered with tomatoes, onions and garlic, often served over rice or with chapati.

steps.instruction: Heat oil in a pot and sauté chopped onion until golden.
Add garlic and chopped tomatoes and cook until the tomatoes break down into a sauce.
Add cooked black-eyed peas, salt and water. Simmer for 15 minutes until the stew thickens. Serve hot.

serving_suggestion: Serve with rice, chapati or ugali.

description: Black-eyed peas simmered in creamy coconut milk with onions and tomatoes, a coastal Kenyan variation.

steps.instruction: Heat oil and sauté onion and garlic until soft.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Stir in cooked black-eyed peas and coconut milk. Simmer for 15–20 minutes until thick. Season and serve.

description: A hearty one-pot Kenyan dish of maize and black-eyed peas cooked with onions, a variation of classic githeri.

steps.instruction: Soak maize and black-eyed peas overnight. Drain and boil in water for 45–50 minutes until tender.
Heat oil and sauté onions until golden. Add the cooked maize and peas.
Season with salt and simmer for 10 minutes. Serve hot.

serving_suggestion: Serve with a side of greens.

description: A smooth, comforting Kenyan soup made from black-eyed peas, onions, tomatoes and garlic.

steps.instruction: Heat oil and sauté onion and garlic until soft.
Add tomatoes and cook until softened. Add black-eyed peas and water.
Simmer for 20–25 minutes, then mash some peas to thicken. Season and serve.

name_en: Black-Eyed Pea and Sweet Potato Mash
description: A traditional-style Kenyan mash of sweet potatoes and black-eyed peas, simple and nutritious.

steps.instruction: Peel and boil sweet potatoes in salted water for 15–20 minutes until soft. Drain.
Add cooked black-eyed peas to the hot sweet potatoes and mash together.
Adjust salt and serve warm.

serving_suggestion: Serve on its own or with a light stew.

description: A hearty Kenyan chickpea stew slow-cooked with tomatoes, onions and mild spices, a filling vegetarian meal.

steps.instruction: Heat oil and sauté onions until golden. Add garlic and curry powder.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook until they form a thick sauce.
Add chickpeas and salt. Simmer for 15 minutes until flavors combine. Serve hot.

description: Chickpeas simmered in a creamy coconut curry with tomatoes and onions, a coastal Kenyan favourite.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion in oil until soft. Add curry powder and tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Add chickpeas and coconut milk. Simmer for 15–20 minutes.
Season with salt and serve with rice or chapati.

description: Chickpeas cooked with spinach, tomatoes and onions, a nutritious Kenyan vegetarian stew.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion until soft. Add tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Add chickpeas and cook for 5 minutes.
Add spinach and salt. Stir until wilted, about 5 minutes. Serve hot.

description: Fragrant Kenyan pilau rice cooked with chickpeas, pilau masala and caramelised onions.

steps.instruction: Fry onions until deep golden. Add pilau masala and chickpeas and stir.
Add rice and stir to coat. Pour in water and salt.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes until rice is tender. Fluff and serve.

name_sw: Curry ya Dengu za Hindi na Mboga
description: Chickpeas cooked with carrots, potatoes and curry powder in a tomato-based Kenyan curry.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion until soft. Add curry powder and tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Add carrots and potatoes and cook for 5 minutes.
Add chickpeas, salt and water. Simmer for 15 minutes until vegetables are tender. Serve.

description: Kidney beans slow-cooked in a savoury tomato and onion sauce, a hearty Kenyan staple.

steps.instruction: Heat oil and sauté onion until golden. Add garlic.
Add tomatoes and cook until they form a sauce.
Add kidney beans and salt. Simmer for 15 minutes. Serve hot.

description: Kidney beans simmered in a creamy coconut and tomato sauce, a coastal Kenyan comfort dish.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion until soft. Add tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Add kidney beans and coconut milk.
Simmer for 15–20 minutes until thick. Season and serve.

description: A traditional Kenyan one-pot dish of maize and kidney beans cooked with onions.

steps.instruction: Soak maize and kidney beans overnight. Boil in water for 45–50 minutes until tender.
Sauté onions in oil until golden. Add cooked maize and beans.
Season with salt and simmer for 10 minutes. Serve hot.

description: A rich, protein-packed Kenyan soup of kidney beans, onions, tomatoes and garlic.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion and garlic in oil until soft.
Add tomatoes and cook until softened. Add kidney beans and water.
Simmer for 20 minutes, mashing some beans. Season and serve.

description: A Kenyan one-pot rice and kidney bean dish cooked with a tomato-onion base.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion until golden, add tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Add kidney beans, rice, salt and water.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes until rice is tender. Fluff and serve.

description: Red lentils cooked into a thick, comforting Kenyan stew with onions, tomatoes and garlic.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion and garlic in oil until soft. Add tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Add red lentils and water. Bring to a boil.
Simmer for 20–25 minutes until lentils are soft and stew is thick. Season and serve.

description: Red lentils simmered in a creamy coconut curry with tomatoes and mild spices.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion until soft. Add curry powder and tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Add red lentils, coconut milk and water.
Simmer for 20 minutes until lentils are soft. Season and serve.

description: A smooth and hearty Kenyan red lentil soup with onions, tomatoes and garlic.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion and garlic until soft. Add tomatoes and cook until softened.
Add red lentils and water. Bring to a boil.
Simmer for 25 minutes, then blend or mash. Season and serve.

description: Red lentils cooked with carrots and potatoes in a tomato-based Kenyan stew.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion until soft. Add tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Add carrots, potatoes, red lentils and water.
Simmer for 25 minutes until lentils and vegetables are tender. Season and serve.

description: A one-pot Kenyan rice and red lentil pilaf cooked with onions and mild spices.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion until golden. Add red lentils and rice and stir.
Add water and salt. Bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes until rice and lentils are tender. Fluff and serve.

description: Yellow lentils simmered with onions, tomatoes and garlic into a creamy Kenyan stew.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion and garlic until soft. Add tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Add yellow lentils and water. Bring to a boil.
Simmer for 20–25 minutes until soft. Season and serve.

description: Yellow lentils simmered in creamy coconut milk with tomatoes and curry powder.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion until soft. Add curry powder and tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Add yellow lentils, coconut milk and water.
Simmer for 20 minutes until lentils are soft. Season and serve.

description: A smooth Kenyan yellow lentil soup with onions, tomatoes and garlic.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion and garlic until soft. Add tomatoes and cook until softened.
Add yellow lentils and water. Boil then simmer for 25 minutes.
Blend or mash for a smooth soup. Season and serve.

description: Yellow lentils cooked with spinach, tomatoes and onions, a nutritious Kenyan vegetarian stew.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion until soft. Add tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Add yellow lentils and water. Simmer for 20 minutes.
Add spinach and salt. Cook for 5 minutes until wilted. Serve.

description: A comforting Kenyan one-pot rice and yellow lentil dish with onions and mild spices.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion until golden. Add lentils and rice and stir.
Add water and salt. Bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes until tender. Fluff and serve.

description: A rustic Kenyan ugali made from sorghum flour, with a nutty, earthy flavour.

steps.instruction: Bring water and salt to a boil in a heavy pot.
Gradually add sorghum flour while stirring continuously to prevent lumps.
Reduce heat and keep stirring for 8–10 minutes until firm. Shape and serve.

serving_suggestion: Serve with sukuma wiki or beef stew.

description: A smooth, fermented sorghum porridge enjoyed warm for breakfast across Kenya.

steps.instruction: Mix sorghum flour with 1 cup water to make a paste.
Bring remaining water to a boil, stir in the paste and salt.
Cook on low heat for 10–12 minutes, stirring, until thick. Sweeten if desired and serve warm.

description: Sorghum porridge enriched with milk, a creamy Kenyan breakfast drink.

steps.instruction: Mix sorghum flour with a little water to form a paste.
Bring remaining water to a boil, stir in paste and cook for 10 minutes.
Add milk and sugar, simmer for 3 minutes and serve warm.

name_sw: Ugali wa Mtama na Sukuma Wiki
description: Sorghum ugali served with sautéed collard greens, a wholesome Kenyan meal.

steps.instruction: Boil water and salt, gradually add sorghum flour and stir until firm. Shape ugali.
Sauté onion in oil until golden. Add sliced collard greens and cook for 5–7 minutes.
Serve the sorghum ugali with the greens.

description: A nutritious Kenyan sorghum porridge enriched with groundnut paste.

steps.instruction: Grind groundnuts into a paste. Mix sorghum flour with water to form a paste.
Boil remaining water, stir in sorghum paste and cook for 10 minutes.
Stir in groundnut paste and sugar. Simmer for 3 minutes and serve.

description: A stiff maize meal porridge, the staple food of Kenya, served with vegetables, meat or fish.

steps.instruction: Bring water and salt to a boil in a heavy pot.
Gradually add ugali meal while stirring continuously to prevent lumps.
Reduce heat and keep stirring for 8–10 minutes until firm. Shape and serve.

serving_suggestion: Serve with sukuma wiki, beans or meat.

description: Kenya's classic meal: stiff ugali served with sautéed collard greens and onions.

steps.instruction: Boil water and salt, gradually add ugali meal and stir until firm. Shape ugali.
Sauté onion in oil until golden. Add sliced collard greens and cook for 5–7 minutes.
Serve hot ugali with the greens.

description: Stiff ugali served with a hearty bean stew, a filling and economical Kenyan meal.

steps.instruction: Prepare ugali by boiling water and salt, adding ugali meal and stirring until firm.
For beans: sauté onion until golden, add tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Add beans and salt, simmer for 10 minutes. Serve with ugali.

description: Stiff ugali served with traditional sour milk, a Kalenjin-inspired Kenyan combination.

steps.instruction: Boil water and salt, gradually add ugali meal and stir until firm. Shape ugali.
Serve the hot ugali with chilled or room-temperature sour milk alongside.
Eat by dipping pieces of ugali into the sour milk.

description: Stiff ugali served with a rich Kenyan beef stew, the ultimate comfort meal.

steps.instruction: Boil beef until tender. Sauté onions and garlic in oil, add tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Add beef and simmer for 15 minutes. Prepare ugali by boiling water and adding ugali meal until firm.
Serve hot ugali with the beef stew.

description: Minced beef cooked with onions and tomatoes into a rich, savory stew, often served with rice or ugali.

steps.instruction: Heat oil and sauté onion until soft. Add garlic.
Add minced beef and cook until browned.
Add tomatoes and salt, cook for 10 minutes. Add water and simmer for 5 minutes. Serve.

serving_suggestion: Serve with rice, ugali or chapati.

description: Minced beef and potatoes simmered in a tomato-onion gravy, a filling Kenyan family meal.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion until soft. Add minced beef and brown.
Add tomatoes and cook until saucy. Add potatoes, salt and water.
Simmer for 20 minutes until potatoes are tender. Serve hot.

description: Fragrant Kenyan pilau rice cooked with minced beef, pilau masala and caramelised onions.

steps.instruction: Fry onions until golden. Add minced beef and brown.
Add pilau masala and rice, stir to coat. Add water and salt.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Fluff and serve.

description: Minced beef stir-fried with shredded cabbage and tomatoes, a quick Kenyan weeknight dish.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion until soft. Add minced beef and brown.
Add tomatoes and cook until saucy. Add shredded cabbage and salt.
Stir-fry for 8–10 minutes until cabbage is tender. Serve hot.

description: Minced beef cooked in a spiced tomato curry sauce with onions and curry powder.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion and garlic until soft. Add curry powder and tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Add minced beef and brown, breaking it up.
Add water and salt, simmer for 15 minutes. Serve with rice.

description: A sweet-sour tamarind drink, popular along the Kenyan coast and enjoyed chilled.

steps.instruction: Soak tamarind pulp in 1 cup hot water for 10 minutes, mash and strain.
Combine extract with remaining water, sugar and grated ginger.
Stir until sugar dissolves, chill and serve over ice.

serving_suggestion: Serve chilled as a refreshing drink.

description: Tilapia simmered in a tangy tamarind and tomato sauce, a coastal Kenyan speciality.

steps.instruction: Soak tamarind in hot water and extract juice. Fry tilapia in oil until golden, remove.
Sauté onion and garlic, add tomatoes and cook until saucy. Add tamarind juice and water.
Return fish to pan and simmer for 10 minutes. Season and serve.

description: Beans simmered in a tangy tamarind and tomato sauce, a flavourful Kenyan vegetarian stew.

steps.instruction: Soak tamarind in hot water and extract juice.
Sauté onion until golden, add tomatoes and cook until saucy. Add tamarind juice.
Add beans and salt, simmer for 15 minutes. Serve hot.

description: Rice cooked with tangy tamarind juice and mild spices, a coastal Kenyan rice dish.

steps.instruction: Soak tamarind and extract juice. Sauté onion in oil until soft.
Add rice and stir. Add tamarind juice, water and salt.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes until rice is tender. Fluff and serve.

serving_suggestion: Serve with fish or bean stew.

description: Chicken pieces simmered in a tangy tamarind and tomato sauce, a Kenyan coastal favourite.

steps.instruction: Soak tamarind in hot water and extract juice. Brown chicken in oil.
Add onion and garlic, cook until soft. Add tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Add tamarind juice, water and salt. Simmer for 20 minutes until chicken is tender. Serve.

description: A traditional Kenyan stew of dried fish cooked with tomatoes and onions, served with ugali.

steps.instruction: Soak dried fish in warm water for 10 minutes, clean and remove bones.
Sauté onions until golden, add tomatoes and cook until softened.
Add fish and water, simmer for 10–15 minutes. Season and serve with ugali.

description: Dried fish simmered in a creamy coconut and tomato sauce, a rich coastal Kenyan stew.

steps.instruction: Soak dried fish in warm water for 10 minutes, drain and flake.
Sauté onion until soft, add tomatoes and cook until saucy. Add coconut milk.
Add fish and simmer for 10–15 minutes. Season and serve.

description: Dried fish cooked with collard greens, onions and tomatoes, a nutritious Kenyan meal.

steps.instruction: Soak dried fish, clean and flake. Sauté onion until golden.
Add tomatoes and cook until saucy. Add fish and cook for 5 minutes.
Add sliced collard greens and salt, cook for 5–7 minutes. Serve.

description: Dried fish simmered with beans in a tomato-onion sauce, a protein-rich Kenyan stew.

steps.instruction: Soak dried fish for 10 minutes, clean and flake. Sauté onion until golden.
Add tomatoes and cook until saucy. Add beans and fish.
Add water and salt, simmer for 10 minutes. Serve hot.

description: A one-pot Kenyan dish of maize, beans and dried fish cooked with onions.

steps.instruction: Soak maize and beans overnight. Boil in water for 45 minutes until tender.
Soak dried fish, clean and flake. Sauté onion until golden, add fish.
Add cooked maize and beans, season with salt and simmer for 10 minutes. Serve.
